_doc: Campaigns are the time-bounded executions of a channel. regionGroupScope pins a campaign to Israel or international so a window never captures a customer from the wrong side of the business; regionScope stays as a descriptive note of the countries we actually saw. windowFrom/windowTo are inclusive MM/YYYY first-payment windows used by the rule engine when no manual override exists. Set windowTo to null for an open-ended campaign.

campaigns.label: Israel founder-led sales
campaigns.description: Every Israeli salon won in person before paid acquisition began.

campaigns.label: Henkel Schwarzkopf Israel partnership
campaigns.description: Henkel bought equipment for salons in their portfolio. The exact salon list is still being reconstructed.

campaigns.label: Salon International London 2023
campaigns.description: Three-day trade show in London. Produced the first cohort of European customers.

campaigns.label: International inbound 2024
campaigns.description: International customers between the trade show follow-up tail and the first paid campaigns.

campaigns.label: US educator masterclasses
campaigns.description: Two masterclasses run by the one educator partner that converted out of five pitched. Their customers produced the UGC that the Meta campaigns were later built on.

campaigns.label: Meta UGC launch
campaigns.description: First paid Meta campaigns using masterclass customer content. Triple-bundle offer launched October 2024.

campaigns.label: Meta UGC scale-up 2025
campaigns.description: Full year of paid Meta acquisition on a small daily budget.

campaigns.label: Israel referrals
campaigns.description: No Israeli acquisition spend after October 2024 — every new Israeli customer is a referral.

campaigns.label: International referrals
campaigns.description: Paid campaigns stopped after November 2025 — international growth from here is referral-driven.

campaigns.label: Portugal distributor rollout
campaigns.description: Distributor purchased 50 annual licences at a rollout price to seed the Portuguese market. Sourced from the London trade show.
